commitResults.messageBody:
Task descriptions and completion flags are stored in parallel arrays,
which separates related state and makes status behavior harder to
maintain.

Introduce a Task class that owns each description and completion state.
Update Bob to store Task objects and delegate marking and display
formatting to them.

Move both classes into the bob package and document their public APIs
to follow the project Java coding standard.

Java changes need a repository-specific standard that agents can apply
consistently.

Add a project skill summarizing the SE-EDU basic and intermediate
rules. Require agents to load it for Java creation, editing, generation,
and review.

Commit messages and branch names need consistent project conventions.

Add a project skill summarizing the SE-EDU Git rules. Require agents
to load it before commit or branch-name work while preserving user
authorization boundaries.

commitResults.messageTitle: Merge main project work into master
commitResults.messageBody:
Bring the student project commits from main onto the repository's
master branch while retaining the setup changes already on master.

Resolve the instruction-file conflict by preserving both sets of
guidance. Keep the Bob refactor from main and remove the superseded
Duke entry point.
